classes.subject: GDEV
classes.titleLong: Graduate Level Ind Study in Development Studies
classes.description: Limited to master's and doctoral degree candidates with permission of the graduate field member concerned.
classes.catalogPermission: Enrollment limited to: master's and doctoral degree candidates.
catalogOutcomes: Summarize and explain major theories and theoretical debates in the disciplines relevant to the student's research question.
Develop original research questions grounded in a review of the existing literature. - Design and complete data collection and analysis for an original piece of research.
Demonstrate competence with the appropriate research methods and research design, depending on the research question.
Develop professional writing and communicating skills.
